title: CMOA Provenance Standard Record
description: A description of the history of transfers of ownership and custody of artwork, using the CMOA Provenance Standard.

period_certainty.title: Period Certainty
period_certainty.description: Are you certain that this period is correct in its entirety?

acquisition_method.title: Acquisition Method
acquisition_method.description: A URI referencing a method from a controlled vocabulary describing the way in which the work changed hands.

event.title: Named Event
event.description: An explicit reference to the event in which this work changed hands

sellers_agent.title: Seller's Agent
sellers_agent.description: A party who assisted the party who was relinquishing the object.

purchasing_agent.title: Purchasing Agent
purchasing_agent.description: A party who assisted the party who was acquiring the object.

transfer_location.title: Location of Transfer
transfer_location.description: The explicit place where the transfer event took place.

timespan.title: Transfer Dates
timespan.description: The dates when the transfer event took place, and optionally the dates when the acquiring party relinquished the object.

botb.title: Begin of the Begin
botb.description: The earliest possible moment the acquisition event could have taken place.

eotb.title: End of the Begin
eotb.description: The latest possible moment when the acquisition event could have taken place.

bote.title: Begin of the End
bote.description: The earliest possible moment when the relinquishing event could have taken place.

eote.title: End of the End
eote.description: The latest possible moment when the relinquishing event could have taken place.

in.title: On this Date
in.description: Used for single-day events, when the BOTB and EOTE are the same date.

begin.title: Begin Date
begin.description: The date the acquisition event took place—used when the BOTB and EOTB are the same date.

end.title: End Date
end.description: The date the relinquishing event took place—used when the EOTB and EOTE are the same date.

stock_number.title: Stock or Lot Number
stock_number.description: A identification number given to the object as part of the transaction

value.title: Purchase Value
value.description: The numeric value of the transaction

currency_symbol.title: Currency Unit
currency_symbol.description: The symbol used to indicate the currency the transaction was denominated in

string.title: Currency Text
string.description: The abount of the purchase price as text

footnote.title: Footnote
footnote.description: An free text field with additional information about the transaction

items.title: Citation
items.description: A bibliographical reference to a primary source that documents the transaction

direct_transfer.title: Direct Tranfer?
direct_transfer.description: Did the transaction directly pass to the acquiring party from the previous period?

text.title: Provenance Text
text.description: The original, unparsed textual representation of this period

birth.title: Birth or Founding Year
birth.description: The first year the party was in existance

death.title: Death or Dissolusion Year
death.description: The last year the party was in existance

relationship.title: Familial Relationship
relationship.description: A party related to the named party.  (Note that the relationship type describes the relationship from the point of view of the this party.  So 'son' means that this party was the father of the named party.

string.title: Name Value
string.description: The textual representation of this name

uri.title: Linked Data URI
uri.description: an explicit link to a URI in an authority file for this name
